This app is built with free pieces made by other people. These are their licenses; tap one to read the full text.
Why should an app charge you every month, fill up with ads or keep an eye on what you do?
For years, having an app on your phone meant accepting a deal nobody really signed: the app is \"free\", but we pay for it with our data, our time and our patience.

Fogón is a small studio that makes apps for everyday life: training, looking after your money, eating better and keeping track of what you watch, read and listen to. Each one with its own face and its own character, cared for down to the last detail.
We don’t copy brands or speak badly of anyone. We do things our own way and let the apps speak for themselves.
There’s always enough for one more.
No subscriptions · No ads · No tracking

string-array.item: No subscriptions: the app comes complete, with no monthly charges.
No tracking: what’s yours stays on your phone and you can export it whenever you want.
